method: Native map controls the horizontal plan and signed frame. Eight actual local exterior files, three HABS exterior/roof photographs, the actual partial Citadel basement drawing and the official DOE later roof photo were inspected. Vertical dimensions, glazing/solar density and fine facade details are photographic estimates, not measured elevations. Original USGS ground frozen before geometry.
scope: Principal connected prison cellhouse, dining/kitchen and administration/hospital envelope. Integral rooftop cylindrical cistern retained; detached island water tower and separate vaulted front cistern terrace/lighthouse/barracks/ruins excluded. Short entrance apron/steps belong to building.

diningJoin.method: Outer envelope splices dining-wing perimeter into main/admin perimeter at their shared west vertex and next east boundary. This closes a native digitization sliver of at most6.5cm; original three part polygons and two raw union components are preserved unchanged. No scale, anchor, heading or source terrain adjustment.
diningJoin.reviewBasis: Native plan and local/HABS photographs show an attached dining wing, not a6cm open trench.

photographicControls.roofMonitorCountAndLength: Interpretation from native plan plus HABS/DOE roof photos; exact as-built skylight survey not available.
photographicControls.roofSolarArray: Rows of later PV modules with clear monitor/service aisles; exact module count not certified. Official descriptions959/1300 differ.
photographicControls.integralRoofCistern: Broad low weathered cylinder and shallow conical cover seen in actual local2010 photograph; distinct from separate island water tower.

physicalEvidence: Real cut wall openings,36cm deep glazing recesses and70cm front-door recess. Grid bars enter at street/closeup; district preserves broad window recesses, skyline preserves native mass/roof cistern and roof-monitor silhouette. Physical coverage and original-source perimeter contact must be checked on actual imported bytes at all four LODs.
terrainPolicy: The original F32 export,66049derived values and review PNG remain unchanged. Hidden foundation envelope is explicitly approximate; it does not establish surveyed footing depth. No terrain fitting, flattening or suppression of source evidence.
limitations: No prison/citadel interiors or walkable collision. Fine armorial carving, lettering, spalling and security equipment generalized.

Standalone shared viewer stage is flat; actual ground-relative contact requires retained original-field fixture and independent geometric source-terrain probes. Synthetic neighbors do not depict Alcatraz Island.
Current roof array geometry is an approximation, not an exact module inventory or a certified post-rehabilitation state.
